evals.prompt: Revise this PR description in evals/files/sloppy-pr.md so it is ready to open.
evals.expected_output: A short PR body with the same facts, no slop patterns, within the 30-line budget, returned without an editing report.
expectations: The output contains no em dash
The output contains none of: powerful, robust, seamless, landscape, streamlines, notification artifact
Routine PR action narration contains no first-person pronoun; it is not treated as a protected quotation
The output keeps the fact that retries back off exponentially
The out-of-scope list is reduced to at most one bullet or removed
The generic conclusion and 'Let me know' closer are removed
The AI-attribution footer is removed
'significantly improves reliability' is replaced by a measured fact or removed, not by an invented number
The output is written in whole sentences, not fragments or arrow shorthand
The response does not append a list of changes made

evals.prompt: Clean up the prose in evals/files/quoted-feedback.md.
evals.expected_output: The customer quote is untouched, including its first person and em dash; the team's sentences are cleaned without losing their qualifiers.
expectations: The quoted customer sentence is reproduced exactly, including 'I' and the em dash
'leveraged' and 'delve' are removed from the team's sentences
'It is worth noting that' is removed
The qualifiers 'may', 'up to two times', and 'only if the first call times out' are all preserved

evals.prompt: Review evals/files/sloppy-pr.md for slop. Do not edit it.
evals.expected_output: One-line findings citing U pattern IDs, most important first, and no changes to the file.
expectations: The file is not modified
Each finding follows '<location> · <ID> <name> · "<quoted text>" · Fix: <rewrite>'
Findings cite U IDs from references/patterns.md, including U1, U5, U17, and U28
Repeated instances of one pattern are grouped into a single finding

evals.prompt: Caveman mode is on. Write the commit message body explaining why the retry cap moved from 5 to 3 attempts: the upstream rate limit is 3 requests per minute.
evals.expected_output: A commit body in whole sentences, because terse chat modes do not apply to commits.
expectations: The commit body uses whole sentences with articles
The commit body states the rate-limit reason
The commit body contains no first-person pronoun

evals.prompt: Tighten this text using only the information here: 'The job runs hourly, ensuring data freshness. This could potentially possibly cause issues.'
evals.expected_output: A concise rewrite retains the schedule and uncertainty without inventing guarantees or failure modes.
expectations: Preserves the hourly schedule
Does not infer a maximum data age or freshness guarantee
Preserves the possibility of issues without inventing dropped messages or another specific failure

evals.prompt: Review this instruction for ambiguity using only this text: 'The client calls the proxy. If it times out, retry.' Do not edit it.
evals.expected_output: A U27 finding requests clarification without choosing the timeout actor.
expectations: Identifies the ambiguous timeout actor under U27
Does not assume the client or proxy is the intended actor
Recommends clarifying the actor rather than supplying an unsupported rewrite

evals.prompt: Rewrite this progress update without first person: 'Let me take a look at the logs.' The log inspection is about to start and has not completed.
evals.expected_output: A brief update preserves the pending or starting action status.
expectations: Contains no first-person pronoun
Does not say the logs were checked or report findings
Describes the inspection as planned or starting
